phrases.text: Video 1 shows the beginning and Video 2 shows the ending of one story. Which option best explains what happened in the missing interval?

The group forms an alliance with the blue creature to fight enemies.
A scientist invents a device to control the collapsing ecosystem.
The protagonists escape to a safe zone through underground tunnels.
The team uncovers and attacks the vines' energy source using special tools.
Leaders negotiate peace between warring factions in the forest.

people in a forest surrounded by magical vines
a group of people in a forest facing a crisis
